comments.headline: Missing Austin Energy transformer pad detail sheets
comments.summary: No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are provided or referenced on any plans. Transformer pad dimensions are not specified. Without pad details and equipment specifications, compliance with UCM § 1.18.0 cannot be verified.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy Design (consultation and detail approval)
comments.attn: Applicant must obtain AE Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets and confirm whether service is single-phase or three-phase. All four pads require detailed specifications.

details.text: No transformer pad dimensions (length × width) are shown on any submitted plan or detail sheet. Reference callouts to AE Design standard details are not present on electrical plan Sheet 21.

runComments.comment: Sheet 21 shows four transformer pad locations but provides no dimensions (length x width). No reference callouts or detail reference bubbles direct readers to Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets. No specification of service type (single-phase or three-phase) is provided. Required transformer pad dimensions and AE Design detail references matching the specified service type are not documented.

No transformer pad dimensions are shown on any submitted plan or detail sheet, and no Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are included. Applicant must obtain from Austin Energy Design the transformer pad detail sheets corresponding to the specified service type (single-phase or three-phase) and provide: (1) dimensioned pad configuration details; (2) equipment specifications including transformer ratings and pad dimensions; (3) confirmation of compliance with AE Design requirements; (4) reference callouts on electrical plan sheet 21 to applicable AE Design standard details.

No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are provided or referenced. Transformer pad dimensions are not specified on the electrical design plan. The UCM § 1.5.2.6 and § 1.18.0 require that pad dimensions match AE Design-approved specifications for the proposed service type (single-phase or three-phase). Without these details, the adequacy and compliance of pad installation cannot be verified.

comments.headline: Transformer clearances to buildings not dimensioned
comments.summary: No dimensional clearance documentation exists for transformer pads relative to buildings, retaining walls, balconies, fences, or windows/doors. Standard 5-foot clearances (or reduced 3-foot clearances to masonry with conditions) cannot be verified. Building elevation and cross-section details are not provided.

Equipment type (oil-filled vs dry-type) affects window/door clearance rules.

runComments.comment: Sheet 21 shows four transformer pad locations but provides no dimension lines or callout notes showing clearance distances from any transformer pad to adjacent buildings. Retaining walls are present on site but clearance distances from transformer pads are not dimensioned. Provide dimensioned plan showing minimum 5-foot clearance from transformer pad edges to all retaining wall structures.

details.text: No dimension lines show clearance distances from pads to adjacent balconies or building overhangs. Vertical elevations or cross-sections are not provided. 5-foot clearance to balconies cannot be verified.
